https://www.tmtpost.com/nictation/820465.title: 【央行10月重要金融数据一览：M2同比增长7.1%，前十个月社融规模增量累计为28.61万亿元】 钛媒体App 11月13日，央行2026年10月金融数据报告出炉。10月末，M2余额359.06万亿元，同比增长7.1%，较上月下降0.1个百分点。M1余额116.9万亿元，同比增长4.4%。M0余额同比增长10.7%。2026年前十个月社会融资规模增量累计为28.61万亿元，比上年同期少2.29万亿元。“目前社会融资成本持续处于低位，总体融资环境是比较宽松的。”业内专家表示，今年以来，人民银行综合运用多种货币政策工具，保持流动性充裕。6月又出台了收窄临时正/逆回购工具操作利率区间、增加隔夜逆回购操作品种的措施，进一步提升了央行流动性管理和短端利率调控的精准性、有效性。近期还在推动银行探索贷款定价基准多元化，利率市场化改革深入推进。（广角观察）

items.title: Conversational AI is going to transform education and deliver personalized tutoring at scale. But we have to build it right.
items.summary:
对话式 AI 将变革教育，实现大规模个性化辅导。但我们必须把它做对。

当前教育领域的大多数 AI 工具都在优化错误的目标：获取答案。但作业的意义不在于产出，而在于通过过程学会思考。我们应该构建帮助学生发展自身思考能力、而非把思考外包给 AI 的 AI。Gakku 正在这样做。

items.summary: 据 The Wall Street Journal 报道，Anthropic 将在本周设定估值区间，计划下周四或周五开始交易。部分机构投资者正推动估值低于上周讨论的 1.5 万亿美元目标，该数字已低于几个月前传闻的 2 万亿美元。报道还提到其主要竞争对手 OpenAI 上周融资 110 亿美元后估值约为 1.25 万亿美元，低于其最初寻求的 200 亿美元融资规模。

items.snippet:

上半年过去了，具身智能可谓是迎来了“盛夏”——头部企业加速落地场景，腰部厂商则

聚焦细分赛道打磨产品。

...

覆盖具身智能企业从种子天使到上市前的股权融资，统计不包含 IPO 上市、上市后定增

及并购交易。

一、上半年具身智能狂奔，融资额暴涨 5 倍 据 IT 桔子数据，2026 年上半年，国内具身智能赛道融资总金额已突破900 亿元，达到

935 亿元，较 2025 上半年提升了 5 倍；融资事件数量达到 322 笔，同比增长了137%，

反映出资本对具身智能赛道的投资信心持续增强。

其中，北京在上半年登顶融资“双冠王”——北京以 100 起融资事件、355 亿元位列全 国具身智能融资最集中的城市；深圳以 61 起融资事件、238.17 亿元融资总额位居国内 城市第二；上海凭借完善的金融生态与科研资源，成为长三角区域的融资核心。

上半年，具身智能赛道极早期阶段（种子轮、天使轮、Pre-A 轮）合计事件数达 190 起， 占总事件数的 58.94%，仍是资本投入的最主要阶段。

其中天使轮事件数突破 100 起，占比超 30%，反映出大量初创企业在资本支持下快速 涌现，行业仍处于技术路线探索与早期项目孵化的高速扩容期，资本愿意承担早期风险，

押注技术突破与创新路线。

成长期阶段（A 轮、A +轮、B 轮、B +轮等）合计事件数达 104 起，占总事件数的32.30%， 融资额占比超 40%。包括自变量机器人、智平方、光轮智能等头部项目均在该阶段完成 数十亿级别的融资，反映出部分具备技术壁垒与商业化落地能力的企业，已从技术验证阶 段迈向规模扩张阶段，成为资本 “押注未来” 的核心标的。

成熟期阶段（C 轮及以后、战略投资）合计事件数达 28 起，占总事件数的 8.70%，以

头部企业的股权融资与战略布局为主。

# AI智能体基础设施公司「以太之心」完成数千万种子轮融资

本轮融资资金将重点投向五大方向：智能体系统迭代与异构硬件适配、AetherStation 产品化与量产准备、团队建设与人才储备、标杆项目落地与渠道建设，以及算力资源与运营储备。

 来源：投资界讯 更新于： 2026-11-13 16:50 3515字 

上海以太之心科技有限公司（下称“以太之心”）成立于2026年，是国内 AI 智能体全栈技术研发企业。投资界（ID：pedaily2012）消息，近日，以太之心宣布完成数千万种子轮融资。本轮融资由上海天使会、浦东创投、高信资本共同参与。以太之心是基于高性能计算底层能力、从硬件到 Agent 全栈协同优化的端侧智能体基础设施厂商，致力于以软硬一体的方式，在本地交付高性能、低成本、数据不出域的 AI 服务。本次融资，印证了资本对端侧 AI Agent 规模化落地赛道的看好，也是市场对以太之心“以有限成本交付恰到好处的智能”技术愿景与产品定位的认可。

...

随着企业智能体从概念验证走向生产落地，行业竞争重心正从“能否接入大模型”转向“能否稳定交付可信业务结果”。以太之心以企业现场真实任务为出发点，在质量、可靠性、时延、成本、隐私合规的多重约束下，统筹模型、软件与硬件，走出一条区别于纯云端调用、传统项目制私有化部署的产品化路径，构建覆盖 Agent、Harness、Model、Hardware 四层协同优化的软硬一体智能体基础设施，核心产品包括智能体 Aeloon 与边缘一体机 AetherStation。

青葵智造完成亿元A轮融资，以自驱动实验体系推动科学研发智能化升级_投资界

# 青葵智造完成亿元A轮融资，以自驱动实验体系推动科学研发智能化升级

资金将重点用于核心技术研发、重点行业拓展以及云实验室建设，加速自驱动实验室的产业化落地。

 来源：投资界讯 更新于： 2026-11-13 10:20 1194字 

青葵智造（北京）科技有限公司（下称“青葵智造”）致力于以自驱动实验室重构科学研发，面向医药研发、能源化工、先进材料、检验检测、高校科研等领域，提供覆盖智能决策、数据管控与实验执行三个层面的全流程自动化与智能化产品及解决方案。投资界（ID：pedaily2012）11月13日消息，青葵智造宣布完成亿元A轮融资，由创东方投资、飞荣达股份及金辉大数据共同参与。本轮融资汇聚专业投资机构、上市公司产业资本及长期老股东等多元力量，资金将重点用于核心技术研发、重点行业拓展以及云实验室建设，加速自驱动实验室的产业化落地。

数字世界中的智能决策，与真实世界中的实验执行尚未充分打通，导致AI生成的方案难以高效转化为可执行任务，实验过程及结果也难以形成可持续利用的数据反馈。因此，构建连接数字世界与物理世界的研发基础设施，是AI4S产业化的核心命题。

青葵智造面向生物医药、化学工业、先进材料、新能源等领域，融合科学智能与实验自动化能力，构建“AI设计—自动化执行—多模态数据回流—模型自适应迭代”的干湿实验闭环，以MoleMind智能决策、AI-LabOS中枢调度、NexoLab物理执行的自驱动实验体系，打通科学决策、实验执行之间的关键环节。

...

同时，数据层面，公司正加快青葵星曜云实验室的建设，探索从设备交付向平台化科研服务延伸的商业模式。云实验室将智能实验设备、AI科学决策及实验数据管理能力整合为可对外提供的研发服务，使产业客户能够以更加灵活的方式获取自动化实验、实验优化与数据分析能力，拓展公司在委托实验、联合研发等领域的服务空间。随着实验场景与服务规模不断拓展，云实验平台有望持续积累高质量实验数据及领域知识，进一步支持科学模型训练、实验方案优化与智能决策能力迭代。

items.title: 互联网快讯_互联网新媒体实时新闻快讯 | 猎云网
items.snippet:
DATE 2026-05-09

## 未来智能完成亿元级A+轮融资

近日，AI硬件公司未来智能完成亿元级A+轮融资，传音参与该轮投资。与此同时，未来智能与传音宣布达成战略合作，双方将共同推动下一代AI Agent硬件产品的研发与落地。 未来智能自成立以来，始终聚焦AI耳机赛道，其推出的viaim讯飞AI会议耳机已连续多年稳居各大电商平台AI耳机销量榜首。截至目前，viaim全球注册用户累计超150万，覆盖50余个行业领域，遍布200余个国家与地区。百万级真实用户的使用场景，使其积累了业内领先的场景化听觉数据资产，形成了“数据飞轮”式的核心壁垒。

2026-05-09

## 造物时代完成数亿元A轮融资

近日，全球消费级CNC领军企业造物时代（Makera）完成数亿元A轮融资，由华映资本、北京市人工智能产业投资基金联合领投，元禾璞华、中科创星、清科创投跟投，老股东启明创投持续超额跟投。 CNC，全称Computer Numerical Control，即用电脑程序指挥机器对材料进行精密切割、雕刻和铣削。相比于3D打印是用塑料和树脂层层堆叠的增材制造，CNC是从一整块材料上精准削掉多余部分的减材制造。 自成立起，造物时代就专注于把工业级加工能力搬上大众桌面：过去，受限于体积庞大、操作门槛高、环境要求严苛等因素，CNC只能在工厂车间里，即便存在少量桌面级产品，也大多处于“半成品”状态，需要用户具备极强的工程背景和组装能力，而造物时代要改变这一现状。

2026-05-09

## 鹰瞰智翼完成数千万元Pre-A轮融资

近日，专注于具身智能仿生扑翼机器人的深圳鹰瞰智翼科技有限公司（下称 “鹰瞰智翼”）宣布，公司已完成Pre-A轮数千万元融资，本轮为元禾原点独家投资。本轮资金将主要用于核心技术研发、流体仿真引擎迭代、消费级与产业级产品矩阵完善及商业化落地拓展。 此前，鹰瞰智翼已连续完成两轮融资，累计融资金额达数千万元。其中，种子轮由奇绩创坛独家战略投资；天使轮由启高资本领投，老股东奇绩创坛持续加注，菡源资产（交大母基金）跟投。

## 共绩科技完成近亿元的Pre-A轮融资

近日，共绩科技完成近亿元的Pre-A轮融资，本轮由春华创投、彼岸时代联合领投，力合中科、阿尔法公社跟投，资金将主要用于技术研发投入和市场拓展。该公司此前还分别获得水木创投、奇绩创坛、新进创投等多家机构投资。 共绩科技成立于2023年，核心团队源自清华大学。公司从创立之初便锚定了一个核心判断：随着AI应用走向普及，推理场景的算力需求将呈现剧烈波动，而现有的粗放式算力供给模式（如长期包租、整机租赁）无法满足这一精细化需求，从而形成了“弹性、低价、稳定”的行业不可能三角。

近日，北京脑回录科技有限公司（Nanoloop）宣布完成千万元种子+轮融资，本轮由南山战新投领投，此前，公司于2024年获得奇绩创坛种子轮投资。本轮资金将主要用于核心技术迭代、产品工程化落地及市场拓展，加速推进运动场景非侵入式脑机接口（BCI）穿戴设备的规模化商用。 脑回录的创新在于，将AI模型、脑机接口技术、定制化运动诱发范式及高精度运动数据标注融为一体的全链条解决方案，同时引入生物力学捕捉与生物生化技术作为核心标签，彻底打破行业瓶颈，重塑运动监测新范式。

...

当模型表现出欺骗、毒性、越权或违背安全红线的行为时，系统能够从预训练和微调阶段定位高影响训练样本，分析这些样本对模型关键组件和风险行为形成的影响，为数据清洗、样本重写和安全再训练提供依据。 ... 构建大模型时代的安全防线是一项长期的系统工程。智源研究院期望以此平台为枢纽，构建“前沿研究 - 工具平台 - 产业应用”的良性闭环。

...

来源：图虫

 头部互联网大厂领投，BV百度风投、云锋基金等顶级资本参与，Synstellation Capital、均胜电子、龙旗科技、上汽金控等产业资本共同投资。 

来源：猎云网

近日，具身智能灵巧手公司临界点（AGILINK）完成数亿元新一轮融资，本轮融资由头部互联网大厂领投，BV百度风投、云锋基金等顶级资本参与，Synstellation Capital、均胜电子、龙旗科技、上汽金控等产业资本共同投资，同时引入C资本、沃赋、慕华科创等多家财务机构。老股东高瓴创投、蓝驰创投继续超额认购。值得一提的是，公司注册一个月内，连续完成多轮融资。

据了解，本轮融资主要用于加速灵巧手与夹爪产品线的研发，完善控制系统与开发工具链，推动具身智能灵巧操作大模型的研发，面向产业客户的交付能力建设，确保灵巧手产品能够实现快速规模化部署。 

上海临界点创新智能科技有限公司成立于2026年1月，团队背景覆盖机器人本体、控制算法、系统工程与产业化经验，目标是在稳定性、可用性与规模化交付能力上，推动灵巧手从“实验室设备”走向“工程化产品”。

临界点将继续专注于灵巧操作这一核心技术，围绕具身智能技术的研发、数据采集、人形机器人与工业场景的应用，逐步构建可复用、可扩展的产品与技术体系。在具身智能快速演进的背景下，临界点希望通过持续投入与稳健推进，成为连接算法、硬件与真实世界应用的关键一环，推动全球具身智能生态的建设，赋能全球制造与机器人产业。

# 2026-01-13 前阿里钉钉最年轻副总裁AI项目攀峰智能获数千万投资， 致力于打造面向未来电商时代的AI Shopify 

来源：企业供图

 本轮融资资金将主要用于产品和AI能力打造、用户增长和AI Native团队的加速构建，快速推进全球首个面向超级个体的内容电商Agent基建。 

近日，由阿里钉钉最年轻的副总裁王铭创立的攀峰智能（K2 Lab）宣布完成数千万元的种子轮融资，由云时资本独家投资，本轮融资资金将主要用于产品和AI能力打造、用户增长和AI Native团队的加速构建，快速推进全球首个面向超级个体的内容电商Agent基建。

K2 Lab的首款产品，全球首个全自动帮达人赚钱的商业Agentic AI——Moras，通过“洞察-创作-分析”，打造了Agent最小单元的在线强化学习飞轮，实现从帮助达人理解内容电商、行业洞察到选品推荐、脚本生成、多镜头视频制作、智能剪辑、商业分析的端到端自动化闭环。

...

Moras的长期愿景是构建多模态的“AI Shopify”，通过AaaS（Agent-as-a-Service）模式为每一个超级个体提供Agent基建，协助超级个体在AI能力底座下更好地管理流量和管理供应链实现商业变现，后续Moras还会陆续推出互动涨粉、情感沟通、私域营销、自动投放等流量管理Agent和物流金融、柔性定制、IP联名等供应链管理Agent，并在通用基建后为头部超级个体打造围绕审美、品味和生活方式的“垂直Agent入口”。积累用户数据，强化用户心智，支持超级个体打造去中心化的生活方式电商入口，最终进化成为新时代需要的的“AI Shopify”

...

据悉，Moras已于年前启动邀测，并计划2026年一季度开启商业化推广和用户增长体系建设。本轮融资后，Moras将通过持续磨合产品、改进算法，强化“洞察-创作-分析”的Multi-Agent架构，并建立LoRA模型矩阵和在线强化学习框架，26年完成快速增长，持续完善KOC生态AI基建。

items.title: With $720M round, Britain's Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips | TechCrunch
items.snippet:
With $720M round, Britain's Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips | TechCrunch

Image Credits: Sam Barnes/Sportsfile for Web Summit via Getty Images

# With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips

 Anna Heim 

11:34 AM PST · November 11, 2026

Fractile, a British startup developing AI chips, has raised a $720 million Series C backed by Britain’s Sovereign AI Fund with hopes of “ensuring the U.K. has a greater stake in the hardware that will underpin its future economy,” its government stated.

Alongside the likes of Axelera, Etched, and OLIX, this makes Fractile one of the top-funded startup players in the race for purpose-built AI chips. Such chips are one of several avenues being explored to reduce the cost of inference — aka using increasingly demanding AI models in production. 

However, Fractile seeks to go beyond hardware with a full-stack approach that also includes a machine learning compiler to maximize the speed at which LLMs will get executed on its chips.

As a result, the company frames itself as a frontier AI company, and its latest round led by Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Redpoint was priced accordingly. According to the British government, the valuation was “over £5 billion” — quite possibly $7 billion, a figure reported both by the Financial Times and a Reuters source.

Still, Fractile’s main differentiator will arguably be its hardware design. After a pivot, its approach now revolves on DRAM, the most common type of RAM, but stacked on top of each chip in such a way that it is hoping will bypass the usual trade-off between memory and capacity.

This trade-off has become more problematic with the rise of agentic AI, as companies seek to perform longer chains of tasks with large models without compromising on speed. As compute struggles to keep up, hopes are high for AI chips, despite their limited availability to date.

# Norwest pushes deeper into AI with new $4B fund

 Kirsten Korosec 

7:18 AM PST · November 12, 2026

Norwest, a firm backed solely by Wells Fargo, has raised a $4 billion fund as it sets out to invest more in AI. This is the eighteenth fund for the 65-year-old multi-stage investment firm, and its largest to date.

The fund will be invested across various sectors and multiple countries, notably the United States, India, and Israel. But the big story here is AI, and Norwest’s plans to expand its investment in this area.

Norwest said Thursday it aims to capitalize on AI startups developing products and services across core industries such as consumer, healthcare, and technology. The investment firm, which has backed Plaid, Spotify, Uber, and Vuori, said it will continue to expand its investments in physical AI, voice AI, agentic cybersecurity, and aerospace.

...

“We’re taking a broad approach to AI because its impact is broad,” Crowe added, as AI is not limited by industry, geography, or application. “Just as digital transformation did, AI transformation has the potential to touch most layers of enterprise, consumer, and healthcare solutions: networking, enterprise IT and applications. Adapting to an agentic environment means applying AI broadly across products and services that solve problems.”

Crowe added that the firm is particularly excited about early-stage companies building AI-native application and infrastructure, physical AI, domain-specific models, and cybersecurity solutions.

Some of the firm’s recent investments reflect this strategy. For instance, the firm invested in Coval, which builds tools to test and evaluate AI agents, and Generalist AI, a startup that has developed AI foundation models for robots.

Since the launch of its seventeenth fund, a $3 billion raise that closed in 2024, the firm has made more than 87 investments.

# Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads

 Tim Fernholz 

6:00 AM PST · November 11, 2026

AI agents are all the rage, but they’re not quite as capable as their purveyors would have you believe. 

Efforts to benchmark agents doing complex tasks show that they aren’t typically reliable enough to function without close supervision. LiveBench 2.0 shows Claude Fable 5.2 and ChatGPT-6 Astra succeeding on 82.9 and 75.6 out of 100 tasks, respectively, and an effort by the AI infrastructure company EON to test agents in a simulated corporate environment found the most successful model tested, Claude Opus 4.8, performed tasks at 76.8% accuracy.

Now, a startup known as Plurai wants to boost those numbers with the same techniques that put self-driving cars on the street: Simulations using synthetic data based on a company’s own digital systems, meant to prepare models to tackle difficult edge cases.

Co-founders Ilan Kadar and Elad Levi previously worked for Nexar, which develops autonomous driving technology. Kadar worked with Waymo to simulate and evaluate its end-to-end deep learning driving software.

“The moment that we saw the wave of AI agents, we saw the same pattern: That it is very easy to build a demo, but [hard] to get something that will be reliable and cost effective,” Kadar told TechCrunch. “Since we saw the same pattern, the same pitch was that we want to build this simulation layer.”

On Wednesday, the startup said it had raised $13 million in seed funding to make that happen. The round was led by Team8, with participation from U&I, Velocity, and Mercer.

# This young startup wants to power floating data centers with the ocean’s heat, and investors are already on board

 Tim De Chant 

12:07 PM PST · November 13, 2026

Anyone who has weathered a hurricane can tell you that the oceans — which fuel the storms — contain a tremendous amount of energy. Thanks to global warming, they’re holding more than ever. 

A new startup wants to harness that energy to power data centers.

Drogue, which has kept a low profile until now, is building a system that harvests heat from the ocean to power data centers on board floating vessels. According to founder and CEO Sam Sipe, the first prototype should be bobbing around the ocean, crunching bits, less than two years from now.

The goal, Sipe said, is to help data center developers deploy servers in AI-friendly timelines. “The data center industry is a real estate game, and so they’re playing on 8- to 10-year timelines, including interoperability with utilities and [independent system operators]” that manage regional power grids, he said. “AI demand has increased 10x in just the last three years. It’s completely incompatible.”

Drogue was founded just six months ago in Washington, D.C., and the startup told TechCrunch exclusively that it has already raised $20 million, including from XYZ Venture Capital, Toyota Ventures, Tamarack Global, Dream, FDVC, Garuda Ventures, Flexcap, Boost VC, and Slow Ventures, among other investors. 

In those six months, Drogue has designed a multi-megawatt prototype that will be installed on a traditional oceangoing ship and sent out to sea in early 2028. Future versions will be built on floating structures that more closely resemble offshore oil platforms.

# Siri co-founder backs Helix for its voice ID tech

 Ivan Mehta 

7:02 AM PST · November 11, 2026

For years, websites have relied on technology like CAPTCHA to prove that the user on the other end is human. More recently, social media platforms have turned to photos or videos to verify users’ identities. Now, a startup called Helix is betting that voice technology can do the same job, without requiring users to hand over sensitive personal information.

The voice technology, which can run directly on a user’s device, has attracted backing from Siri co-founder Dag Kittlaus, who will also act as an adviser.

The company raised $6.2 million in funding in a round led by Chicago Ventures, with participation from BAM Ventures, Aglaé Ventures, Corazon Capital, Press On Ventures, Tusk Ventures, Yonder Ventures, Rule 30, and Brown Angel Group.

The startup was founded by Alex Oberg, Anna Dorofiyenko, and Mike Hall in 2025. Oberg previously worked at Ticketmaster, which acquired his startup; Dorofiyenko led data science teams at Live Nation and Zillow; and Hall has worked at Nike and Tinder, where he helped develop the initial matching algorithm.

...

Its core technology can run directly on a device to determine whether someone is human and estimate their age. The company is also running pilots to explore whether voice can be used as a biomarker to detect conditions such as drunkenness or distress.

The company can deploy its technology to replace or supplement CAPTCHA and help block bot attacks. Helix said that because its model can run locally even on an iPhone 13, the cost of deploying the technology is minimal. The startup said one of its customers is Zeel, an in-home healthcare provider that uses Helix’s tech to verify the identities of providers visiting customers’ homes.

Image Credits: Heather Diehl / Getty Images

# Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say

 Marina Temkin 

 Dominic-Madori Davis 

2:43 PM PST · November 13, 2026

It was the resignation heard across the world. Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s embattled CEO who co-founded and led the company for 33 years, had officially stepped down. “It’s like a bomb went off,” one neocloud founder told TechCrunch when he first heard the news. 

Over the last several years, Nvidia has been a prolific investor, pouring tens of billions into startups annually and participating in 105 rounds this year alone, often as the largest investor, according to PitchBook. “If that direction changes, it’ll be a big blow to so many young companies,” said Maria Davidson, founder of Relational Capital. 

Huang’s absence leaves the startup ecosystem without one of its biggest champions and with far less capital for now, investors say, which could have a massive impact on dealmaking, valuations, funding, and even competition. 

“Nvidia is carrying almost every AI-native startup from application to neocloud,” Dawn Capital’s Shamillah Bankiya told TechCrunch. 

Most of the significant decisions to invest in startups often came from Jensen himself, according to Umesh Padval, managing partner at Seligman Ventures. Padval has known Huang since serving on the board of Mellanox Technologies, a networking chipmaker Nvidia acquired for approximately $7 billion in 2020. While there is hope that Huang’s eventual successor will resume his dealmaking spree, investors aren’t hopeful that it will happen in the short term.

# Mirendil Raises $1B to Democratize Frontier AI R&D

 Mirendil 

Nov 12, 2026, 12:30 ET

SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, we're announcing that we've raised $1B in a Series A, led by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake Capital, with participation from Battery Ventures, Doerr Capital, Gil & Co, Google, M13, Pear VC, and S32, among other new and existing investors.

We believe making AI R&D more accessible is the most direct path to AI that solves humanity's most pressing problems across science and technology. We're building tools to democratize frontier AI R&D and help put it within reach of every scientist and engineer.

Over the past three weeks, we've shared our first results, and they point to the same shift: when agents do the hands-on work, the size of your team stops limiting what you can build. One researcher, working with agents, pretrained Mirendil-Base, a competitive coding model, from scratch in 3.5 months with less than $10M in compute. We then post-trained it into Fern, which holds up to 10M tokens of context, enough for days of an agent's work. And Lor, now in private beta, brings this way of working to everyone else: hundreds of agents writing code and running experiments for days at a time. Mirendil runs on Lor every day.

# 融资7亿美元，Fractile要将AI推理速度提高100倍

阿尔法公社· 2026年11月13日 19:53

AI推理的产业竞争不再只是造一颗芯片。

AI的推理计算将在未来几年内成为AI最重要的计算需求，已经逐渐成为共识。

推理计算，拆解开来有两个重要维度，成本和时间。 

其中提升推理速度带来的好处，在AI逐渐Agent化的时代，重要性凸显。

具体来说，在相同成本下提升推理速度，能让那些耗时长、推理强度高的Agent任务在更短时间内完成，从而提高整个系统的效率。

Fractile是一家全栈AI推理公司，致力于从零构建AI的底层推理技术，突破推理计算在“成本与延迟”之间的帕累托前沿限制。

它的初步目标是将AI推理速度提升至现有硬件的100倍，并将成本降至十分之一。

近日，据媒体报道，Fractile完成新一轮约7亿美元融资，本轮融资由Lightspeed和Redpoint领投，Thrive Capital参与投资，这使它的估值从此前的10亿美元升至65亿美元。

2026年5月，它获得由Accel、Factorial Funds以及Founders Fund联合领投的2.2亿美元的B轮融资，参与本轮融资的还有Conviction、Gigascale、O1A、Felicis、Buckley Ventures和8VC等机构。

更早之前，Intel前CEO Pat Gelsinger也对该公司进行投资。

此外，据彭博社报道，Anthropic已向Fractile下达了一份价值2.5亿美元的初步芯片订单。

...

Fractile目前尚未完全公开底层芯片细节，但可以确认它采用的是存内计算（in-memory compute）架构。这一机制无需再将模型参数在内存与处理器芯片之间来回搬运，而是直接将计算操作内嵌于内存之中。

...

目前，Fractile尚未正式推出商业化量产芯片。在转向DRAM堆叠方案后，模拟与测试结果显示， 其芯片推理速度可达现有GPU的10到25倍 ，并继续保持十分之一的成本优势。按照计划，该计算平台将于2027年下半年开始量产爬坡。

items.snippet:
清华 Nature 封面团队创业，幂级智能连续完成三轮数亿元融资｜星连被投动态-36氪

# 清华 Nature 封面团队创业，幂级智能连续完成三轮数亿元融资｜星连被投动态

星连资本· 2026年11月12日 11:16

 幂级智能聚焦世界模型的更底层问题：物理智能的最终来源是什么？

物理人工智能（Physical AI）基础模型公司幂级智能（DenseAI）完成第三轮融资，半年内累计融资金额达数亿元人民币，投资方包括北京、深圳头部国资、知名美元资本和顶级AI生态投资基金等。

幂级智能成立于2026年，是一支从清华大学自动化系走出来的顶尖AI团队，致力于打造下一代物理世界基础模型，以世界模型与密集学习（Dense Learning）为核心，推动人工智能从理解物理世界走向自主学习与持续进化。

在世界模型成为全球AI竞争热点的当下，幂级智能选择了一条差异化的技术路线：以大规模存量的、边际成本极低的真实物理数据作为智能来源，以原创的密集学习技术突破数据的稀疏度灾难和长尾难题，实现物理智能的高效率预训练、高水平后训练，最终让智能体具备在物理世界中持续进化的能力。

...

在幂级智能看来，规模化的数据是智能的来源，制约物理AI规模化发展的关键瓶颈，不仅是模型架构和算力，更是可规模化的真实物理数据。把物理世界中海量的、已经记录下来的、最真实的数据，通过密集学习，高效率的压缩成智能，这就是物理智能的诞生方式。

公司认为，物理世界模型的高价值数据源需要满足三个条件：足够低的边际成本、充分的真实物理信息，以及从第一天就具备大规模扩展的能力。围绕这一判断，幂级智能重点探索以世界为中心（World-centric）的真实交互视频数据，利用人类在工业生产、日常生活等真实场景中自然产生的物理活动，构建低成本、可持续扩展的预训练数据体系，降低对特定机器人本体和昂贵动作标注的依赖。

公司希望通过真实场景形成“场景产生数据、数据训练模型、模型反过来赋能场景”的持续增长飞轮，为物理世界模型建立真正可规模化的训练基础。据悉，公司世界模型已经在某全球机器人赛事中提供底层技术支撑，并开始在真实场景中商业化交付，初步完成产品市场验证。

# 清华 Nature 封面团队创业，幂级智能连续完成三轮数亿元融资｜星连被投动态

星连资本· 2026年11月12日 11:16

 幂级智能聚焦世界模型的更底层问题：物理智能的最终来源是什么？

物理人工智能（Physical AI）基础模型公司幂级智能（DenseAI）完成第三轮融资，半年内累计融资金额达数亿元人民币，投资方包括北京、深圳头部国资、知名美元资本和顶级AI生态投资基金等。

幂级智能成立于2026年，是一支从清华大学自动化系走出来的顶尖AI团队，致力于打造下一代物理世界基础模型，以世界模型与密集学习（Dense Learning）为核心，推动人工智能从理解物理世界走向自主学习与持续进化。

在世界模型成为全球AI竞争热点的当下，幂级智能选择了一条差异化的技术路线：以大规模存量的、边际成本极低的真实物理数据作为智能来源，以原创的密集学习技术突破数据的稀疏度灾难和长尾难题，实现物理智能的高效率预训练、高水平后训练，最终让智能体具备在物理世界中持续进化的能力。

...

在幂级智能看来，规模化的数据是智能的来源，制约物理AI规模化发展的关键瓶颈，不仅是模型架构和算力，更是可规模化的真实物理数据。把物理世界中海量的、已经记录下来的、最真实的数据，通过密集学习，高效率的压缩成智能，这就是物理智能的诞生方式。

公司认为，物理世界模型的高价值数据源需要满足三个条件：足够低的边际成本、充分的真实物理信息，以及从第一天就具备大规模扩展的能力。围绕这一判断，幂级智能重点探索以世界为中心（World-centric）的真实交互视频数据，利用人类在工业生产、日常生活等真实场景中自然产生的物理活动，构建低成本、可持续扩展的预训练数据体系，降低对特定机器人本体和昂贵动作标注的依赖。

公司希望通过真实场景形成“场景产生数据、数据训练模型、模型反过来赋能场景”的持续增长飞轮，为物理世界模型建立真正可规模化的训练基础。据悉，公司世界模型已经在某全球机器人赛事中提供底层技术支撑，并开始在真实场景中商业化交付，初步完成产品市场验证。

# Czech startup ValkaAI extends pre-Seed round to €13 million to bring AI personas to live events at scale

By Rahul Raj

November 13, 2026

ValkaAI, a Czech DeepTech company developing real-time generative AI that lets digital personas react to live events, has extended its pre-Seed funding round to €13 million.

This round was backed by Look AI Ventures, alongside ff Venture Capital. In February 2026, the company announced it raised its first external capital—€12 million in pre-seed funding—led by Rockaway Ventures, with participation from J&T Ventures, Tensor Ventures, BD Partners, Fond Naše Česko, and Petr Zámečník.

...

Founded in 2025 by Vlastimil Venclík (CEO) and Miloš Lokajíček (COO), ValkaAI builds digital personas for live sports, esports, gaming, and media, where one live experience can be adapted to different audiences, languages, and platforms. The company is on a mission to build a new category: AI-native entertainment. Live entertainment runs on reactions: the voice that rises when the game turns, the expression that tells you something just happened. 

ValkaAI claims to build AI models that let digital personas do exactly that, understanding live events and responding through speech, facial expressions, and movement.

...

ValkaAI is not building on existing generative AI models; it is developing its own across three research areas: video generation, audio generation, and event understanding. It is also tackling the challenge of making all three work together live, so its personas react naturally and in sync without getting in the way of the experience.

...

The company plans to use the capital to accelerate research into real-time video and audio generation, hire senior AI researchers, and help bring its technology to commercial partners.

Nebuly, a Turin- and New York-based startup that helps enterprises measure the return on investment from their AI agents, has raised €18.95 million ($21 million) in a Series A funding round.

The round was led by Planven, with participation from Exor Ventures, Tenacity Capital, TGVG Capital, and Fastweb+Vodafone via Founders Factory, alongside turning investors and angels. CDP Venture Capital SGR also participated in this round through its Artificial Intelligence Fund and Digital Transition Fund, backed by the European Union’s NextGenerationEU programme.

...

Founded in 2022 by Francesco Signorato, Julien Roux, and Diego Fiori, Nebuly analyses what AI agents actually do inside an organisation, across both employee-facing tools and customer-facing assistants. It consolidates its analysis into a single view, with internal deployments measured in the form of efficiency gains such as hours saved and capacity freed up, while also offering insights into new tasks the teams can take on.

For customer-facing AI, it tracks revenue influenced by agents and surfaces signals such as churn risk and upsell opportunities. The platform connects to agents businesses already use, including those built on Claude, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot, and customers can choose to run on-premises or within a customer’s private cloud.

November 12, 2026

SE3, a Munich-based spatial intelligence provider for autonomous systems, today announced that it has raised €27.04 million ($30 million) in Series A funding. 

The round was led by Accel, with participation from Keen, Lakestar, and Seedcamp. The company plans to use this capital to grow its engineering, commercial, and operations teams and prepare to fulfil additional contracts as it scales. It also intends to strengthen its presence in Germany and Ukraine, open an office in the UK, and plans to expand further across Europe. Its immediate focus remains defence, with plans to explore robotics, emergency response and other civilian applications for demanding environments from 2027.

...

SE3 was founded in 2023 by Lukas Köstler (CEO), Simon Klenk (CTO), and Chief Science Officer Professor Daniel Cremers. It spun out of Cremers’ computer vision lab at the Technical University of Munich (TUM), where Köstler and Klenk were working on PhDs in computer vision and robotics. Professor Cremers holds TUM’s chair for computer vision and AI, and is a recipient of the Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize, Germany’s most prestigious research award. SE3 is building the spatial intelligence technology that enables machines to perceive, reason and act autonomously in the physical world. The company claims to bring AI to the physical world. It combines computer vision and AI to help machines turn sensor data into spatial understanding, enabling autonomous operation. The German startup states that it is developing its technology for complex environments where systems must work reliably, including when satellite navigation is disrupted.

# 2026-02-11 聚焦具身智能灵巧操作底层能力建设，临界点再获数亿元融资 

来源：图虫

 头部互联网大厂领投，BV百度风投、云锋基金等顶级资本参与，Synstellation Capital、均胜电子、龙旗科技、上汽金控等产业资本共同投资。 

来源：猎云网

近日，具身智能灵巧手公司临界点（AGILINK）完成数亿元新一轮融资，本轮融资由头部互联网大厂领投，BV百度风投、云锋基金等顶级资本参与，Synstellation Capital、均胜电子、龙旗科技、上汽金控等产业资本共同投资，同时引入C资本、沃赋、慕华科创等多家财务机构。老股东高瓴创投、蓝驰创投继续超额认购。值得一提的是，公司注册一个月内，连续完成多轮融资。

据了解，本轮融资主要用于加速灵巧手与夹爪产品线的研发，完善控制系统与开发工具链，推动具身智能灵巧操作大模型的研发，面向产业客户的交付能力建设，确保灵巧手产品能够实现快速规模化部署。 

上海临界点创新智能科技有限公司成立于2026年1月，团队背景覆盖机器人本体、控制算法、系统工程与产业化经验，目标是在稳定性、可用性与规模化交付能力上，推动灵巧手从“实验室设备”走向“工程化产品”。

临界点将继续专注于灵巧操作这一核心技术，围绕具身智能技术的研发、数据采集、人形机器人与工业场景的应用，逐步构建可复用、可扩展的产品与技术体系。在具身智能快速演进的背景下，临界点希望通过持续投入与稳健推进，成为连接算法、硬件与真实世界应用的关键一环，推动全球具身智能生态的建设，赋能全球制造与机器人产业。

作为一家专注于具身智能时代机器人末端执行器的全球化科技公司，临界点致力于为具身智能机器人提供可靠、高性能的灵巧操作与数据闭环解决方案。以赋能机器人，加速智能生产力走进千行百业、千家万户为使命，临界点正在努力定义具身智能进入工厂和家庭的“最后 10 厘米”，突破通用人工智能（AGI）在物理世界的临界点。

# 2026-02-02 AI医药研发解决方案提供商深度智耀完成6000万美元新一轮融资 

来源：图虫

 凯泰资本、信宸资本、金镒资本，老股东鼎晖百孚和新鼎资本共同投资。 

来源：猎云网

近日，AI医药研发解决方案提供商深度智耀（DIP）完成6000万美元新一轮融资，本轮融资由凯泰资本、信宸资本、金镒资本，老股东鼎晖百孚和新鼎资本共同投资。

北京深度智耀科技有限公司成立于2018年4月，是AI驱动型药物研发与商业化平台，致力于通过AI重塑药物临床研发全流程。公司已服务全球数千家药企与生物科技公司，作为“AI定义临床”的倡导者，深度智耀正通过技术赋能，大幅缩短新药上市周期，降低研发成本，造福全球患者。

深度智耀提出的“电子神经元单点无效论”与基于脑科学理念构建的“原子化智能体”协同系统，正在将AI从辅助工具升级为具备专业意识、可协同进化的“数字科学家团队”。这一范式跃迁，正是AI在制药领域走向通用化（AGI）的关键路径。该平台的核心亮点在于其类人的自主进化机制。通过假设‑验证‑反思‑修正的闭环，系统能不断识别知识盲区与逻辑漏洞，并完成对智能体的自主优化与重构。这种自我迭代能力，结合四层防护机制带来的99.9%工业级精度，使AI能可靠地应用于临床试验方案设计等严肃医疗场景，也为平台的长期价值积累奠定了坚实基础。

深度智耀近期推出的“Protocol Rehearsal（方案预演智能体）”，通过在虚拟空间中完整模拟临床试验，实现对入组、脱落、资源消耗等关键节点的精准预测。这一创新不仅有望大幅降低临床开发的不确定性与成本，更标志着AI正从“流程优化”走向“决策前置”，推动新药研发向“智能决策密集型”模式转型。

# 2026-01-20 山海实业与CSI联合领投，宇泛智能完成Pre-IPO+轮融资 

来源：图虫

 本轮融资资金将重点用于机器人本体、多模态大模型、通用机器人“大小脑”、世界模型等核心能力建设，以及东南亚等海外市场的业务拓展与本地化布局。 

来源：猎云网

近日，人工智能企业宇泛智能宣布完成Pre-IPO+轮融资，折合人民币5.13亿元。本轮融资由温州苍南县“山海实业集团”与马来西亚“Crewstone International (CSI)”联合投资，老股东“博将资本”继参与宇泛智能B2轮、C2轮投资之后，此次Pre-IPO+轮继续加码。 

本轮融资资金将重点用于机器人本体、多模态大模型、通用机器人“大小脑”、世界模型等核心能力建设，以及东南亚等海外市场的业务拓展与本地化布局，进一步夯实公司在AI2.0阶段的技术积累与全球化发展基础。

宇泛智能创立于2014年，公司致力于通过人工智能与机器人技术，将人类从“3D”（Dull、Dirty、Dangerous）的工作中解放出来。

在AI1.0阶段，宇泛智能以人脸识别技术为起点，逐步拓展至多类视觉感知与行为识别算法，并实现从AI算法到智能硬件的全栈布局，构建了AI与电子工程深度融合的技术体系。AI2.0阶段，宇泛智能持续推进以多模态大模型为核心的系统性布局，推动智能能力从“视觉感知”向“感知—推理—决策—执行”的闭环能力演进。目前，公司已在端侧多模态大模型、空间认知模型、具身智能硬件与系统级控制架构等方向展开深度研发，为新一代通用机器人及复杂场景智能体的规模化应用奠定基础。

# 2026-01-16 融资18亿！奥特曼杀入马斯克脑机地盘 

来源：图虫

 押注非侵入式技术路线。 

来源：猎云精选，文/韩文静

当马斯克的Neuralink忙着推进脑机接口量产计划时，他的“老对手”萨姆·奥特曼已悄然完成18亿元融资，押注一条完全不同的路径——

1月15日，据外媒消息，由OpenAI CEO萨姆·奥特曼（Sam Altman）联合创立的脑机接口公司Merge Labs，近期已筹集了2.52亿美元（约合18亿元人民币）的种子轮融资，远超绝大多数神经科技公司的早期融资规模。

这次，奥特曼选择了非侵入式技术路径，无需将电极植入大脑的设备，而是利用超声波等具有深层穿透能力的方式来发送和接收信息，这与马斯克的侵入式策略形成鲜明对比。

...

Merge Labs的融资，意味着奥特曼与马斯克的竞争从人工智能领域延伸至脑机接口赛道。

...

而这场竞争并未止步于人工智能领域，近年来，两位科技巨头不约而同地将目光投向了人机交互的终极入口——脑机接口。作为侵入式脑机接口的先行者，马斯克对Neuralink的布局稳步推进，2025年6月，Neuralink完成了6.5亿美元的E轮融资。今年年初，马斯克还在社交媒体宣布，Neuralink要在今年实现脑机接口的大规模量产。

而奥特曼也早已盯上该赛道。2025年10月，Merge Labs悄然成立，明确押注非侵入式技术路线，开启了与马斯克在在脑机接口领域的短兵相接。最新的进展是——Merge Labs成功斩获2.52亿美元（约合18亿元人民币）种子轮融资。

尽管公司成立仅数月、员工不足50人，甚至未公布产品原型，Merge Labs却吸引了顶级资本目光。

据知情人士透露，OpenAI是本轮融资的最大出资方，这意味着Merge Labs或将直接嫁接OpenAI的核心算法能力，实现脑机接口与先进AI技术的深度融合，这也是其区别于其他脑机接口公司的核心优势。

此外，公司其他投资者还包括贝恩资本，以及全球最大游戏发行平台Steam的联合创始人Gabe Newell。Gabe本人创立过一家脑科学公司Starfish Neuroscience，进一步强化了Merge Labs的技术背景。

Merge Labs表示，其长期使命是连接生物智能与人工智能，以最大化人类能力、能动性和体验。为实现这一目标，公司正在开发全新范式的脑机接口，这些接口能与大脑展开高带宽交互，并集成先进的人工智能，最终做到安全且人人可用。

...

Merge Labs与Neuralink的核心分歧，在于对脑机接口技术路线的选择——奥特曼团队坚定押注非侵入式，而马斯克则深耕侵入式，两条路径各有优劣，背后是对技术逻辑、应用场景与商业化节奏的不同判断。

...

Merge Labs则旨在开发一种侵入性更低的脑机接口技术，无需进行开颅手术，例如，通过基因疗法与超声波模态实现神经信号传输，不仅用于医疗康复，还可以成为健康人群也能日常使用的消费级脑机设备。

...

2026年1月初，强脑科技完成约20亿元人民币融资，该公司侧重于非侵入式技术，通过在大脑和外部设备间建立信号通路提供解决方案。公司目前已获得美国FDA及欧洲CE认证，核心产品“超级传感器”可在不开颅情况下检测脑电信息，用于辅助残疾人康复及治疗阿尔兹海默症、自闭症等脑疾病。

一句话总结：2026年三季度，中国 一级市场 “量 ”全面修复 ——单季3,566起创近两年新高；但 “价 ”的分配极度 收敛 —— 45.8%的资金流向1.2%的项目，美元占比与国资占比双双创出新高，市场进入超级项目时代。

截止 日期：2026年9月30日 数据来源：IT桔子 © itjuzi.com

先看总量：2026年第三季度，中国创投市场共发生融资事件 3,566 起，环比增长 22.8%，同比增长 42.1%；

披露融资总额达 4,248.1 亿元，环比增长 4.8%，同比增长 74.3%。2026年前三个季度事件数分别为 2,971 起、2,905 起、3,566 起，Q3 单季首次突破 3,500 起，为 2025 年以来最高水平。

从单笔融资规模看，平均融资金额升至 1.19 亿元，较2025年同期的 0.97 亿元提升 23%；但单笔融资中位数维 持在 2,000 万元，与去年完全持平，均值与中位数的剪刀差扩大至 6.0 倍。

分月看，7 月 1,245 起（1,641.5 亿元）、8 月 1,122 起（1,102.2 亿元）、9 月 1,199 起（1,504.3 亿元），三季度 各月事件数均站稳 1,100 起以上，7 月与 9 月各出现 一个明显的资金投放高峰，市场活跃度呈 “高位平台 ”而非

“脉冲行情 ” 。

一 、市场全景（续）： 一半的钱，流向1%的项目 但总量扩张的另 一面，是结构性的极致分化：10 亿元以上的超大额交易仅 43 起（占比 1.2%），却拿走 1,946.6 亿元，占全部披露金额的 45.8%；与此同时，1,000 万元以下的小额融资有 881 起（占比 24.7%），金额贡献

仅 0.4%。

也就是说，市场的 “量 ”在普遍修复，而 “价 ”的分配逻辑高度倾斜。Q2 出现的 DeepSeek 508.8 亿元 A 轮、Q3 出现的月之暗面 35 亿美元 F 轮、可灵 AI 30 亿美元 A 轮，正在不断抬高市场对 “超级项目 ”的心理预期。均值 上行、中位数不动，是这种 “哑铃型 ”资金结构最直白的数据注脚。

上半年，具身智能赛道极早期阶段（种子轮、天使轮、Pre-A 轮）合计事件数达 190 起， 占总事件数的 58.94%，仍是资本投入的最主要阶段。

其中天使轮事件数突破 100 起，占比超 30%，反映出大量初创企业在资本支持下快速 涌现，行业仍处于技术路线探索与早期项目孵化的高速扩容期，资本愿意承担早期风险，

押注技术突破与创新路线。

成长期阶段（A 轮、A +轮、B 轮、B +轮等）合计事件数达 104 起，占总事件数的32.30%， 融资额占比超 40%。包括自变量机器人、智平方、光轮智能等头部项目均在该阶段完成 数十亿级别的融资，反映出部分具备技术壁垒与商业化落地能力的企业，已从技术验证阶 段迈向规模扩张阶段，成为资本 “押注未来” 的核心标的。

成熟期阶段（C 轮及以后、战略投资）合计事件数达 28 起，占总事件数的 8.70%，以

头部企业的股权融资与战略布局为主。

items.snippet:
Sand.ai完成2亿美元融资，10个月累计融资3亿美元，跻身独角兽行列

# Sand.ai完成2亿美元融资，10个月累计融资3亿美元，跻身独角兽行列

 作者：王圆磊 

昨天 11:18

...



...

 10 个月内累计融资额达 3 亿美元，正式跻身独角兽行列。 

亿欧11月5日消息， Sand.ai 宣布完成2亿美元A+轮融资。这是公司2026年完成的第三轮融资， 10个月内累计融资额达3亿美元，本轮融资后正式跻身独角兽行列。

本轮融资汇聚了产业资本、知名人民币及美元基金、上海国资等多方投资力量。其中，基石资本、网宿科技（300017.SZ）联合领投；时代资本、国方创投、磐霖资本、东证资本等知名机构参投；天创资本携山东铁投产投、山东铁路基金战略参投；浦东创投等上海国资背景机构加入；经纬创投、华业天成、中科创星等老股东持续加注。

本轮融资资金将主要用于视频基础模型研发、训练与推理基础设施建设、产品迭代及全球市场拓展。Sand.ai 新一代更大参数规模的 MoE 架构视频生成基础模型 MAGI-2 正式版，将于近期发布。

...

Sand.ai（三呆科技）自成立之初便专注于视频生成基础模型及应用产品研发。公司持续探索视频生成模型的技术架构，从自回归生成、音视频联合建模，逐步推进至千亿参数级 MoE 模型，在模型能力和推理效率方面取得了一系列突破。

2025 年 4 月，Sand.ai 发布并开源自回归视频生成模型 MAGI-1，通过按时间顺序生成视频片段，支持视频连续生成与长时延展。2026 年 3 月，公司进一步开源 MagiHuman，采用统一的单流 Transformer 架构，对文本、画面和声音联合建模；并通过 MagiAttention、MagiCompiler 等基础设施技术，提升大规模视频模型的训练与推理效率。

2026 年 8 月，Sand.ai 发布并开源 MAGI-2 Preview，成为全球首个将视频生成模型扩展至千亿参数规模并开放模型权重的团队。该模型采用超细粒度 MoE 架构，总参数量约 114B，单次前向计算激活约 6B 参数，在扩大模型容量的同时控制计算开销，10秒1080P视频的推理成本仅0.5元「蒸馏后模型」。在第三方评测平台 Artificial Analysis 的图生视频榜单中，MAGI-2 Preview 发布时位列全球第六。

...

随着本轮融资完成，Sand.ai 将继续推进下一代大规模视频模型研发，探索开源基础模型与应用产品的协同发展，进一步拓展全球开发者生态与商业化应用。

# 智星时代完成数千万元B轮融资，冠驰控股集团独家战略投资，领跑行业场景AI Agent新赛道

 2026-11-03 10:45 

 2026年11月2日，国内行业场景AI Agent应用工具开发商智星时代（上海）工业智能科技有限公司（以下简称"智星时代"）正式宣布完成数千万元B轮融资。 

2026年11月2日，国内行业场景AI Agent应用工具开发商智星时代（上海）工业智能科技有限公司（以下简称"智星时代"）正式宣布完成数千万元B轮融资。本轮融资由冠驰控股集团独家战略投资，资金将重点投向云秒嗒智能体平台技术迭代、垂类行业场景深度落地、核心研发团队扩充及全国市场商业化布局，全面加速企业级AI Agent产品的规模化落地与生态扩张。

# Berlin-LA startup Opdo raises $2.3M to automate optical engineering with AI

 The startup combines AI-driven design, simulation and manufacturing data to reduce development cycles from months to weeks, targeting bottlenecks in quantum computing, aerospace and advanced sensing. 

 Cate Lawrence 12 November 2026 

 

Opdo, an AI-native optical engineering company, has raised $2.3 million in pre-seed funding to accelerate its ambition of automating optical engineering, from initial design to finished components. 

The Los Angeles and Berlin startup is developing a self-improving system that connects AI-driven design and simulation with real-world manufacturing data, and has already demonstrated its ability to reduce end-to-end development and manufacturing cycles from months to weeks. For more than a year, Opdo has worked alongside customers to design complex optical systems, combining AI agents with specialist engineering expertise. Its technology operates within established optical design software, including Zemax and CODE V, allowing engineers to accelerate their workflows without replacing existing tools. Opdo’s own engineers provide additional design expertise, and customers can also source prototypes and finished components through the company. Optics underpins technologies ranging from quantum computing and aerospace to AR/VR, defence and advanced sensing. Yet designing and manufacturing optical components remains slow and labour-intensive, with growing demand for specialist engineers creating bottlenecks across these industries. Opdo aims to overcome these constraints by connecting digital design with physical production. Data from manufactured and tested components can feed back into its AI models, improving subsequent designs and progressively automating the journey from initial requirements to production-ready optical systems.  Cate Lawrence 12 November 2026 

 

European deeptech scaleups have raised more than €4 billion since joining the EIC Scaling Club, an EIC-funded initiative supporting promising European deeptech companies. According to a new report, their funding has grown 2.3 times faster than that of comparable businesses, measured against funding raised before joining the programme. 

The EIC Scaling Club, running under the EIC Business Acceleration Services, launched its first cohort in April 2024, followed by a second cohort in October 2024. 

The latest report analyses the funding performance of the Club’s portfolio of 120 companies across 26 European countries, using data up to 29 September 2026. 

## Deeptech scaleups outperform comparable companies 

Of the 119 active companies, 56 per cent raised funding after joining the Club, compared with 38 per cent of companies in a control group of 240 eligible applicants who were not selected.

Among companies that secured investment, Club members raised an average of €60.6 million, compared with €39.7 million for the control group. 

## New Space and Next-Gen Computing attract the largest investments

 The report reveals that investment is increasingly concentrated in technologies considered critical to Europe’s future competitiveness, resilience and technological sovereignty. Companies in New Space and Next-Gen Computing attracted the largest volumes of funding, securing €1.34 billion and €1.32 billion respectively, followed by Renewable Energies with €589 million.

 Biomatter develops a computational platform for designing custom enzymes tailored to specific chemical reactions, helping companies in pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, agriculture and industrial biotechnology accelerate enzyme development.

Biomatter, a company specialising in custom enzyme design, has raised $18 million in an oversubscribed Series A funding round led by Astanor, with participation from existing investors UVC Partners, Inventure and Metaplanet.

Biomatter develops computational technology to design enzymes tailored to specific chemical reactions and industrial applications. Rather than modifying existing natural enzymes, the company focuses on creating enzymes based on the chemistry required for a particular process.

Enzymes play an important role in industries such as pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, agriculture and industrial biotechnology. However, conventional enzyme development can take months or even years, particularly when naturally occurring enzymes are unsuitable for specific applications.

To address these challenges, Biomatter combines computational models with laboratory testing to develop enzymes with properties suited to customers' requirements. Its technology draws on a proprietary dataset of experimentally characterised enzymes, which expands with each development programme. According to the company, its enzyme design process currently takes weeks rather than months or years.

Biomatter has developed custom enzymes for enterprise customers across Europe, the United States and Japan, including AstraZeneca, BASF, Sanofi and Tereos. Its technology is also used in commercial products, including an enzyme developed in collaboration with Thermo Fisher Scientific to improve stability for molecular biology and mRNA research applications.

# SoftBank leads $500M funding round in Agile Robots

 Agile will use the funds to expand in the US and boost production. 

 John Reynolds 12 November 2026 

 

SoftBank has led a $500m funding round in German humanoid robotics startup Agile Robots that automates industrial work. 

The Japanese multinational led the Series F funding round, which also features Nvidia, Hitachi, and T Capital and valued Agile at $8.5bn. Agile has raised around $2bn in total. 

The Munich-based robotics company manufactures robotic arms, hands, autonomous mobile robots and humanoid robots, as well as building the software and AI models behind the tech.

Its robots carry out work such as assembling products, handling components, inspecting equipment and moving materials around factories.

Founded in 2018 as a spin-off out of the German Aerospace Centre, Agile said it would use the new funds to expand in the US and boost production capacity.

Earlier this year, Agile opened a factory close to Munich, which can make up to 10,000 legged and ⁠wheeled humanoid robots a year, the company said. Agile employs over 2,000 research and development specialists and holds over 650 patents. Its customers include automotive, consumer electronics, healthcare and service industries.

Agile CEO and founder Dr. Zhaopeng Chen said: “Physical AI will fundamentally change how the world builds, moves and makes things. Our vision is intelligent robots working alongside people in factories and warehouses everywhere, and Agile Robots is determined to lead that shift.

"We bring Physical AI out of the lab and into industrial production, across logistics, automotive, electronics and manufacturing. This funding allows us to accelerate our global expansion, strengthen our presence in key markets and build out production capacity.”

items.title: Agile Robots Raises $500M Series F Funding at $8.5 Billion Valuation
items.snippet:
Agile Robots Raises $500M Series F Funding at $8.5 Billion Valuation

# Agile Robots Raises $500M Series F Funding at $8.5 Billion Valuation

 By FinSMEs 

November 13, 2026

Agile Robots, a Munich, Germany-based startup that develops AI-controlled humanoid and industrial robots that automate manufacturing, assembly, and warehouse work, raised a $500m Series F funding round at a valuation of $8.5 billion. 

The round was led by SoftBank Group, with participation from Nvidia, Hitachi Ventures, and T. Capital. 

The company, which has raised a total of about $2 billion, intends to use the funds for increased production capacity and expansion into key markets. 

Led by CEO and Founder Dr. Zhaopeng Chen, Agile Robots builds and deploys Physical AI – humanoid and mobile robots, robotic arms and hands, and the software and AI models behind them – to help industrial customers automate tasks that have traditionally relied on human dexterity and judgment. Its customers include leaders in the automotive, consumer electronics, healthcare and service industries. 

Agile Robots has more than 20,000 robotic solutions installed worldwide and plans to strengthen its presence in the United States and accelerate the development of innovative robotics applications. In addition, the company will continue to build out production capacity, including in Germany. Early in 2026, Agile Robots opened a new production site at Fürstenfeldbruck, near Munich, Germany, to meet rising demand. The site has the capacity to produce up to 10,000 legged and wheeled humanoid robots annually.

items.title: BluWave-ai Raises $8.1M in Funding
items.snippet:
BluWave-ai Raises $8.1M in Funding

# BluWave-ai Raises $8.1M in Funding

 By FinSMEs 

November 13, 2026

BluWave-ai, an Ottawa, Canada-based provider of an AI energy optimization platform, raised $8.1M in Series A-2 equity, non-dilutive federal financing, and operational capital.

The equity round saw participation from new and returning international angel and family office investors including several from Capital Angels Network. The operational capital was provided by Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Bank of Montreal (BMO).

The raise brought the total amount to over $24M.

The company intends to use the funds to consolidate its Canadian operations and engineering team, expand its patent portfolio, enhance its Energy Storage Autopilot solution, and accelerate international business development in partnership with Global Affairs.

Founded in 2017 and led by CEO Devashish Paul, BluWave-ai works with electricity utilities, independent power producers, and EV fleet operators to optimize renewable energy, battery storage, dynamic pricing markets, EV charging, and data center energy use in real-time. Their platform operates from a shared AI engine and includes EV Everywhere for managed charging, Energy Storage Autopilot for stationary batteries, and Data Center Autopilot for flexible AI compute loads, supported by a portfolio of 17 granted or allowed international patents and over 84 filed. 

They serve deployments across North America and Asia, including partnerships in Ontario with Oakville Hydro, Oshawa Power, and Essex Powerlines.

# Chamath Palihapitiya just took his first full-time operating job since Facebook — and the $135M cap table behind it reveals what the AI coding war is really about

Chamath Palihapitiya is returning to a full-time operating role for the first time since leaving Facebook, taking the CEO seat at 8090 Labs after the AI coding startup closed a $135 million Series A led by Salesforce Ventures, according to TechCrunch.

## The deal

8090 Labs, founded by Palihapitiya in January 2024, sells an enterprise AI coding product called Software Factory — a tool pitched at corporate programming teams that want production-grade output with audit trails and compliance controls rather than the vibe-coded prototypes that have become shorthand for consumer-grade AI development. The round was led by Salesforce Ventures, with participation from Jeffrey Katzenberg’s WndrCo, David Sacks’ Craft Ventures, fellow All-In hosts David Friedberg and Jason Calacanis, and angel cheques from Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora and Quora CEO Adam D’Angelo.

# Swiss AI inspection company Delvitech raises €34.5M: Know more 

Image credits: Delvi Tech

Swiss firm Delvitech secured €34.5M in a Series B investment round. to make electronics manufacturing faster and more accurate.

Rancate, Switzerland-based Delvitech, a company that develops AI-native solutions for automated optical inspection in electronics manufacturing, has secured $40M (approximately €34.5M) in a Series B investment round.

The round was led by EGS Beteiligungen (EGSB), the Investment Company of the Ernst Göhner Foundation, together with CREADD Ventures, and joined by several prominent European private investors.

With a projected 400 per cent growth by the end of 2025, the Swiss company will use the funds to grow and expand its presence in India.

It plans to open a manufacturing facility there in 2026, with a goal of producing more than 200 machines each month by 2030.

## Delvitech: 3D Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) 

Founded by Roberto Gatti, Delvitech designs, manufactures and supplies a sustainable AI-based technological solution for the 3D automated optical inspection of assembled printed circuit boards.

Their technology combines advanced neural networks with flexible hardware to provide accurate inspections for challenging materials like clear adhesives, micro-pitch connectors, and plastic components used in printed circuit boards (PCBs).

By using self-learning algorithms, the company’s platform minimises the need for manual programming and enhances both accuracy and speed.

# Kutlerri.ai raises $4 Mn from Narahari Investments to expand AI solutions for restaurants 

## Houston and Bhubaneswar-based startup Kutlerri.ai has raised $4 million from Houston-based Narahari Investments. The fresh capital will be used to expand its AI Catering Sales Agent, launch three other AI 

Gyan Vardhan

 13 Nov 2026 13:10 IST

Houston and Bhubaneswar-based startup Kutlerri.ai has raised $4 million from Houston-based Narahari Investments.

The fresh capital will be used to expand its AI Catering Sales Agent, launch three other AI agents currently in beta testing and develop a mobile-first self-service application for restaurant operators, the startup said in a press release.

Co-founded in December last year by Kiran Rana and Payal Tripathy, Kutlerri.ai is building AI agents to help restaurants improve sales, manage expenses and increase profitability. It follows a performance-linked pricing model, charging customers based on additional revenue generated or costs saved rather than fixed subscription fees.

The startup currently has more than 10 signed customers in the US. Its product development and engineering operations are based in Bhubaneswar, while it also operates an office in Houston. Ankit Narain and Rishabh Srivastav are also part of the founding team.

Its first commercial product, the AI Catering Sales Agent, identifies potential catering customers within a 30-mile radius, contacts them through emails, texts and calls, and helps restaurants convert enquiries into orders.

The product was developed with RASA, a five-location fast-casual restaurant group in the Washington DC region. According to Kutlerri.ai, the agent helped RASA generate $450,000 in additional catering revenue over 10 months, more than 10 times the amount paid for the service, without hiring additional sales personnel.

# Desible.ai raises Rs 32 Cr led by Prime Venture Partners 

## Bengaluru-based AI startup Desible.ai has raised Rs 32 crore in a funding round led by Prime Venture Partners, with participation from existing investor Invention Engine. Snippets 

Shashank Pathak

 13 Nov 2026 10:28 IST

Bengaluru-based AI startup Desible.ai has raised Rs 32 crore in a funding round led by Prime Venture Partners, with participation from existing investor Invention Engine.

The fresh capital will be used towards strengthening its agentic AI capabilities, expanding compliance infrastructure, accelerating product development and scaling sales and marketing operations.

Founded in 2025 by Uttam Tiwari and Omkar Raikar, Desible.ai is building an AI-powered workflow orchestration platform for banks, non-banking financial companies (NBFCs) and insurance providers.

The platform helps financial institutions automate customer engagement, servicing, collections, underwriting and compliance processes. It initially focused on voice-based automation and is expanding to channels such as WhatsApp, SMS and email.

Desible.ai currently supports more than 25 workflows across revenue generation, risk and compliance, collections, customer service and claims. 

The company claims its platform handles over 10 million customer engagements every month and works with insurance providers, while more than 40 BFSI institutions are using or evaluating its solutions.

Its platform integrates with existing enterprise systems and uses predefined decision-making rules to ensure customer consent, regulatory disclosures and escalation procedures are followed. The compliance framework is aligned with requirements from IRDAI, RBI, TRAI and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act.

MGF-Kavachh leads Rs 18 Cr seed round in climate startup mistEO

# MGF-Kavachh leads Rs 18 Cr seed round in climate startup mistEO 

## Thiruvananthapuram-based climate intelligence startup mistEO has raised Rs 18 crore in a seed funding round led by MGF-Kavachh, with participation from Seafund and other investors. 

Gyan Vardhan

 12 Nov 2026 16:51 IST

Thiruvananthapuram-based climate intelligence startup mistEO has raised Rs 18 crore in a seed funding round led by MGF-Kavachh, with participation from Seafund and other investors.

The funding was announced at HUDDLE GLOBAL 2026, the eighth edition of the event.

The startup will use the proceeds to scale its flagship Climate Decision Intelligence (CDI) platform for banks, insurers and agricultural value chains across India and Asia.

Founded in 2019 by Samuel John and Ambarish Narayanan, mistEO combines weather modelling with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning to convert weather and climate data into actionable insights.

Its CDI platform integrates satellite, radar, Internet of Things (IoT) and ground-sensor data to help financial institutions and businesses assess the impact of weather events on farms, assets and loans.

The company’s proprietary forecasting model, Indra, provides weather forecasts at a spatial resolution of 3 km across three time windows: 0-6 hours, 6-24 hours and 24-48 hours.

mistEO also develops solutions for maritime operations, renewable energy forecasting, logistics and mobility, and flood and heavy-rainfall monitoring.

...

Incubated at Social Alpha, mistEO is headquartered in Thiruvananthapuram and also operates an office in Melbourne, Australia. It plans to strengthen its forecasting and risk models, expand its team and build partnerships across Asian markets.

# EloElo Group raises $80 Mn in Series C led by Hornbill Capital, NBCUniversal 

## Bengaluru-based consumer AI and entertainment company EloElo Group has raised $80 million in a Series C funding round led by Hornbill Capital and NBCUniversal. 

Harsh Upadhyay

 04 Nov 2026 10:44 IST

Bengaluru-based consumer AI and entertainment company EloElo Group has raised $80 million in a Series C funding round led by Hornbill Capital and NBCUniversal. The round also saw participation from MIT Investment Co. and existing investors Play Ventures, Kalaari Capital, Waterbridge Ventures, Griffin Gaming Partners and others.

The fresh capital will be used to fund original content across languages, support the international launch of its micro drama platform Story TV, and expand investments in Dolphin AI, its agentic AI creative suite.

Founded in 2020 by former Flipkart executive Saurabh Pandey, EloElo Group operates Story TV, a micro drama platform, alongside Master, a micro learning platform, Dolphin AI and Voxy AI, an AI companion agent. Story TV offers over 5,000 micro dramas across six languages, with a new drama launched every three hours. The platform records 95 minutes of daily time spent per user, according to the company.

The company owns the content, distribution and AI-powered production engine behind its entertainment business. Across its apps, EloElo Group has over 40 million monthly active users and has crossed 300 million installs.

The latest funding round takes the company's total capital raised to $130 million which includes a $13.5 million Series B round raised in April 2025.

EloElo said it achieved multi-fold revenue growth over the past year and has scaled with profitable unit economics. EloElo began monetising in May 2024 and reported revenue of Rs 69.5 crore in FY25, with losses remaining largely flat. Its FY26 results are yet to be filed.

# Asia Digest: NatureSelect.ai raises over $100m; Aulis Capital closes debut $200m fund

Photo from NatureSelect.ai

Eudora Wang

11 November, 2026

Chinese AI emotional companion startup NatureSelect.ai has attracted more than $100 million in new financing, while ex-Qiming managing partner Nisa Leung’s Aulis Capital has reached the final closing of its inaugural fund.

### AI emotional companion startup NatureSelect.ai raises over $100m 

Shenzhen-based startup NatureSelect.ai, which develops artificial intelligence (AI) emotional companion products, has raised more than $100 million in new financing ahead of a new product launch this month.

5Y Capital, Qiming Venture Partners, SCV, iMPC and HyT Capital backed NatureSelect.ai in the new financing.

Founded in early 2024, NatureSelect.ai develops AI-driven experiences promoting long-term human-AI relationships. Its key products include EVE, a 3D AI companion equipped with long-term memory. Beyond text, voice, and video interactions, EVE can proactively execute real-world tasks, such as ordering boba tea or flower deliveries, bridging virtual companionship with everyday life for users.

The startup is also developing Elys, an agentic social network where user interactions naturally generate contextual memory. Leveraging this data, personalised AI avatars can help users surface high-value insights, build meaningful connections, and explore new experiences across the platform.

Since its launch of Elys in private beta this February, the startup has made progress in optimising the multi-user social memory system, while enhancing privacy protection and improving connection efficiency. Currently, the latest version of Elys remains in invite-only beta testing, with the official version expected to launch this month.

The startup counts BAI Capital, Ubiquant Partners, Eastern Bell Capital, and HSG among its early backers.

FILE PHOTO: Robots are displayed at the Agile Robots booth at the Hannover Messe, one of the world's largest industrial trade fairs with Brazil as this year's partner country, in Hanover, Germany, April 20, 2026. REUTERS/Fabian Bimmer/File Photo
Reuters
12 November, 2026
Agile Robots has raised $500 million in a funding round led by SoftBank, valuing the German robotics company at $8.5 billion, it said on Thursday. Nvidia and Hitachi also took part.
The Munich-based maker of humanoid robots and robotic arms said it would use the money to expand in the US and add production capacity, including in Germany.
Earlier in 2026, Agile Robots opened a factory in Fürstenfeldbruck, near Munich, to meet what it described as rapidly rising demand. The site can produce up to 10,000 legged and wheeled humanoid robots a year, the company said.
Founded in 2018 as a spin-off from the German Aerospace Center, Agile Robots employs more than 2,000 research and development specialists and holds over 650 patents.
**Reuters**

items.title: 李书福称吉利完全认同换电模式，“车电不同寿”的矛盾还没集中爆发
items.summary: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据观察者网报道，11 月 5 日，蔚来创始人、董事长兼 CEO 李斌与吉利控股集团董事长李书福，在 2026 世界互联网大会乌镇咖荟 · 汽车夜话进行对话。这是双方在 9 月 28 日蔚来与吉利达成充换电战略合作后的首次公开对话。李书福表示，吉利完全认同换电模式，新能源车电池是会衰减损坏的，但一台车的使用周期不止七八九年，这个矛盾必须找到解决方案，“直接换一块全新电池包，太贵；拆解翻新修复电池，成本同样很高。所以换电，就是解决这个问题。”据IT之家此前报道，9 月 28 日，蔚来与吉利控股集团达成充换电领域全面战略合作。双方达成技术、运营、资本全方面合作共识，将联合投资双方充换电业务主体公司，共享充换电技术与标准，共建充换电服务网络。吉利控股集团将以其持有的易易互联 100% 股权及现金 6.4 亿元入股蔚来能源，交易完成后，吉利控股集团将持有蔚来能源 30% 股权，易易互联营运车辆换电业务将并入蔚来能源，蔚来能源将持续提升营运车辆换电网络的运营，赋能易易互联营运车辆业务；双方将共建统一的 C 端换电技术和标准，吉利控股集团将开发面向 C 端的换电车型，蔚来能源将为吉利控股集团 C 端换电车型提供服务。

items.title: AI 公司迄今最大发电设备采购订单：曝 Anthropic 砸 34 亿美元买燃气发电机
items.summary: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据英国《金融时报》今天（8 日）晚间报道，Anthropic 签下了一份大额数据中心燃气发电机组采购订单。随着发电设备供应日趋紧张，AI 公司开始绕过中间商直接采购，进一步涉足能源行业。报道披露，9 月下旬，Anthropic 斥资 34 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 227.49 亿元人民币），从美国得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥的设备供应商 OnePWR Solutions 手中接下总功率达 1.7GW 的重型发电机组订单。按照已知交易记录，这是 AI 公司迄今规模最大的一笔发电设备采购订单，也反映出科技企业为争夺电力供应，正不断向能源行业延伸。以往，AI 公司通常依靠公用事业公司和专业电力企业供电。但燃气轮机、发电机组需求激增，设备交货期延长至数年之后，资金雄厚的 AI 公司开始跳过中间环节，直接掌握发电能力。据知情人士透露，OnePWR 两年前就向卡特彼勒订购了发电机组，仍需融资才能完成采购。Anthropic 原本打算向 OnePWR 购买服务，后来改变主意，直接接手了 OnePWR 向卡特彼勒下达的设备订单。直接采购发电设备也帮助 SpaceX 迅速投入运营大型数据中心。今年早些时候，SpaceX 旗下 xAI 斥资 20 亿美元（现汇率约合 133.82 亿元人民币）购入移动式燃气轮机。谷歌母公司 Alphabet 则在 2025 年底收购了能源开发商 Intersect。Anthropic 选择了另一种方式：不收购整家公司，也不只是单纯买设备，而是接手多年前、设备涨价前签订的订单。部分发电机组近期就能交付，其余设备也将在未来两年内到位。Anthropic 同时是 SpaceX 的大客户。预计到今年年底，Anthropic 每月向 SpaceX 支付的算力租赁费用将达到 31 亿美元（现汇率约合 207.42 亿元人民币）。

items.title: 苏姿丰：AMD 是一家数据中心优先的公司
items.summary: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，当地时间 11 月 5 日，AMD 首席执行官苏姿丰（Lisa Su）在接受雅虎财经采访时，将该公司描述为一家“数据中心优先（data center first）”的企业。IT之家注意到，该表态发生在 AMD 公布其 2026 财年第三财季（2026 年 6 月 28 日～2026 年 9 月 26 日）财务业绩之后，财报显示其数据中心收入比去年几乎翻了一倍。在与雅虎财经主播 Brian Sozzi 交谈时，苏姿丰解释说，人工智能的落地普及速度远超许多企业的预期。过去习惯按照年度制定投资规划的公司，如今正在更频繁地调整预算，以应对与日俱增的算力需求。对此，AMD 正通过提升供应产能，并与客户协同推进更大规模的系统部署来予以应对。我们是一家数据中心优先的公司（We are a data center first company），这就是我们的定位，而且人们需要更多的计算来驱动所有这些应用。相关阅读：《AMD 2026 财年前三季度报归母净利润 61.08 亿美元，同比增长 116.29%》《AMD CEO 苏姿丰：今年是真正的“AI 推理之年”》
